test_title: PYST 55: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Break a leg
solution:
The correct answer is Option (3) i.e. **'To wish someone good luck'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Break a leg:** A way of wishing good luck (सौभाग्य की कामना करना)

 
 
• **Example**: Before going on stage, the actor's friends told him to break a leg.
 
 
 
• **To wish someone good luck: **(किसी को शुभकामनाएं देना) - Expressing hope for someone's success.
 
• This option 3 aligns with the idiomatic expression used to wish success in a performance or endeavor.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'To wish someone good luck'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **To hurt someone: **(किसी को नुकसान पहुंचाना) - Physically or emotionally damaging someone.
 
• **To avoid someone: **(किसी से बचना) - Intentionally keeping distance from someone
 
• **To love someone: **(किसी से प्यार करना) - Feeling deep affection for someone.

4a:T99a,

The correct answer is Option (4) i.e.** 'To express an idea with great precision'.**
